title: Mud mud ke jana ali akbar
body:
Mud mud ke jaana Ali Akber (2)
Baap Tere aata Hai gir gir Kar
Mud mud ke jaana Ali Akber
1) Hooke juda Mai tujh se
jiyoon kyun Kar
Ruk ja baita dehkhlon gi bhar kaar (2)
Ruk ruk ke ye khehte the sarwar
Mud mud ke jaana Ali Akber (2)
2) husne Yusuf Teri perchaie
Tu Hai mere aankhoon ki binaiee (2)
Baita tu hamshakle paighambar
Mud mud ke jaana Ali Akber (2)
3) chaiee huwi Hai harso tariki
qatm huwi binaie aankhoon ki (2)
Laagti hai har gham.pa ek tookhar
Mud mud ke jaana Ali Akber
4) aas bhi tooti phootagaie kismat Arman bhikre oojada gaie Zainab (2)
Kaise jiyegi ab Teri madar
Mud mud ke jaana Ali Akber (2)
5) maaka Tha armaan dhula banane ka Tere sar Pai sehra sajane ka (2)
Phir gaya Pani maaki hasrat par
Mud mud ke jaana Ali Akber (2)
6) reh Takti Hai oodhar behen sugra
iedhar sakina dehkhti Hai Rasta (2)
Koon sambhale inne ko aye Akber
Mud mud ke jaana Ali Akber (2)
7) koon Nazar sarwar ko Sahara de
Aake ghazi nehrse baatla de (2)
Laash Jawan ki uthagi kyun Kar
Mud mud ke jaana Ali Akber (3)
